notes:
Remove the circular region search and stabilize server-list loading.

- Remove the region-search circle while keeping automatic regions for the current UI page.
- Prioritize server listing before automatic region lookups; stop obsolete page lookups on navigation.
- Reuse cached CSRF tokens instead of requesting an authentication token for every server, and preserve rate-limit signals from authentication.
- Limit automatic region address queries to three simultaneous requests and skip unnecessary queries for full servers.
- Handle server-list HTTP 429 with a visible, cancellable wait and continue from the same cursor.
- Preserve loaded servers during throttling and refresh, reduce request frequency after limits, and prevent repeated-cursor loops.
- Keep offline geolocation, cached regions, filters, account data and update notifications.

Roblox may still impose request limits. The application now waits and resumes rather than treating each expected limit as a failed refresh.
